gloss: to carry out thoroughly; to see through to the end

definitions.gloss: to carry out thoroughly; to see through to the end; to accomplish completely
definitions.explanation: To persist with something from start to finish without giving up, ensuring complete execution of a plan, belief, or course of action.

examples.japanese: {意志|いし}を{貫徹|かんてつ}する。
{最後|さいご}まで{方針|ほうしん}を{貫徹|かんてつ}した。
examples.english: I saw the policy through to the very end.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}に{直面|ちょくめん}しても、{自分|じぶん}の{信念|しんねん}を{貫徹|かんてつ}することが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Even when facing difficulties, it is important to see your beliefs through to the end.

notes:
Describes the act of carrying something out completely and thoroughly without wavering. Emphasizes determination and persistence through the entire process.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {意志|いし}を{貫徹|かんてつ}する: to carry out one's will
- {方針|ほうしん}を{貫徹|かんてつ}する: to see a policy through
- {信念|しんねん}を{貫徹|かんてつ}する: to hold firm to one's beliefs
- {目的|もくてき}を{貫徹|かんてつ}する: to accomplish one's objective

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {貫|つらぬ}く: to pierce through / to stick to — focuses on the act of persisting, less formal
- {遂行|すいこう}する: to carry out / to execute — focuses on completing a task or duty, more bureaucratic
- {徹底|てってい}する: to be thorough — emphasizes thoroughness rather than seeing something through from start to finish

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. Common in written language, speeches, and news reporting. In everyday conversation, {貫|つらぬ}く or {最後|さいご}までやる are more natural.
